params.negative_prompt: music, melody, voice, speech, crowd, birds

directions.angle: a punchy cannon shot with a hard tight transient and a deep chest-hitting thump, compressed and close-miked
a cannon shot with heavy low-end: a sub-bass thump under the bang, a short low boom tail, like a kick drum and an explosion in one
a cannon shot with a fat round boom, a deep whomp of air, a brief rumble, recorded close, no echo, no room
a cannon shot with a sharp crack on top and a deep punch underneath, powerful and dry, recorded next to the barrel

normal.prompt: Game sound effect, no music, no voice. A small iron cannon on a castle wall fires once: {angle}. Over in about a second.

big.prompt: Game sound effect, no music, no voice. A huge heavy siege cannon fires once: {angle}, but massive, much bigger and deeper than a normal cannon, a window-shaking sub-bass boom with a long low rumble tail and a faint metallic ring of the barrel.
